scriptLines: query: 'SELECT CAST(patient_id AS INT) AS patient_id_bk, CAST(full_name AS NVARCHAR(250)) AS nombre_completo, CAST(CASE WHEN gender = \'M\' THEN \'Masculino\' WHEN gender = \'F\' THEN \'Femenino\' ELSE \'Otro\' END AS VARCHAR(20)) AS genero, CAST(date_of_birth AS DATE) AS fecha_nacimiento, CAST(CASE WHEN date_of_birth IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, date_of_birth, GETDATE()) <= 18 THEN \'0-18\' WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, date_of_birth, GETDATE()) <= 35 THEN \'19-35\' WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, date_of_birth, GETDATE()) <= 60 THEN \'36-60\' ELSE \'60+\' END AS VARCHAR(50)) AS rango_etario, CAST(email AS VARCHAR(255)) AS correo_electronico, CAST(address AS NVARCHAR(500)) AS direccion, CAST(COALESCE(insurance_provider, N\'Sin Seguro\') AS NVARCHAR(150)) AS proveedor_seguro FROM silver.patients UNION ALL SELECT CAST(-1 AS INT) AS patient_id_bk, CAST(N\'Paciente Desconocido\' AS NVARCHAR(250)) AS nombre_completo, CAST(\'Otro\' AS VARCHAR(20)) AS genero, CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS fecha_nacimiento, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50)) AS rango_etario, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(255)) AS correo_electronico, CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(500)) AS direccion, CAST(N\'Sin Seguro\' AS NVARCHAR(150)) AS proveedor_seguro',
